executive_summary: Maven test compilation failed with 100 errors across 3 test classes. The root cause is a major refactoring where the domain model changed from using primitive types (long) to UUID for IDs, and Priority enum was renamed to TaskPriority. Additionally, service method signatures were updated to require userId parameter. All test classes need to be updated to match the new domain model and service interfaces.

errors.message: Priority enum cannot be converted to TaskPriority (occurs 13 times)
errors.root_cause: The Priority enum was renamed to TaskPriority in the domain model, but test code still references the old Priority enum name.
errors.fix_recommendation: Replace all occurrences of 'Priority' with 'TaskPriority' in TaskControllerTest.java. Update import statement from 'com.myproject.models.dtos.Priority' to 'com.myproject.models.dtos.TaskPriority'.

errors.message: long cannot be converted to UUID (occurs 10 times)
errors.root_cause: Task IDs were changed from long to UUID type, but test code still uses long values for task IDs.
errors.fix_recommendation: Replace all long task ID values with UUID.randomUUID() or UUID.fromString() calls. For example, change 'long taskId = 1L' to 'UUID taskId = UUID.randomUUID()'.

errors.message: createTask method signature mismatch - missing userId parameter (occurs 12 times)
errors.root_cause: TaskService.createTask() method signature was updated to require userId as first parameter, but test mocks still call it with only TaskCreateRequest.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all when(taskService.createTask(...)) calls to include userId as first parameter: when(taskService.createTask(anyString(), any(TaskCreateRequest.class))). Add userId variable in test setup.

errors.message: getUserTasks method signature mismatch - requires String userId, int page, int size, String sortBy (occurs 9 times)
errors.root_cause: TaskService.getUserTasks() method signature changed to require 4 parameters including sortBy, but tests call it with only 3 parameters and pass long instead of String for userId.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all getUserTasks calls to: when(taskService.getUserTasks(anyString(), anyInt(), anyInt(), anyString())). Change userId from long to String type in test data.

errors.message: TaskCountResponse constructor and countUserTasks method signature mismatch (occurs 3 times)
errors.root_cause: TaskCountResponse constructor changed and countUserTasks method now requires String userId instead of long.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update TaskCountResponse instantiation to use builder pattern or correct constructor. Change userId parameter from long to String in countUserTasks calls.

errors.message: getTaskById method signature mismatch - requires UUID taskId and String userId (occurs 4 times)
errors.root_cause: TaskService.getTaskById() method signature changed to require both UUID taskId and String userId parameters.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all getTaskById calls to: when(taskService.getTaskById(any(UUID.class), anyString())). Ensure taskId is UUID type and userId is String.

errors.message: updateTask method signature mismatch - requires UUID taskId, String userId, TaskUpdateRequest (occurs 6 times)
errors.root_cause: TaskService.updateTask() method signature changed to require UUID taskId and String userId as first two parameters.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all updateTask calls to: when(taskService.updateTask(any(UUID.class), anyString(), any(TaskUpdateRequest.class))). Convert taskId from long to UUID.

errors.message: deleteTask method signature mismatch - requires UUID taskId and String userId (occurs 4 times)
errors.root_cause: TaskService.deleteTask() method signature changed to require both UUID taskId and String userId parameters.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all deleteTask calls to: when(taskService.deleteTask(any(UUID.class), anyString())). Convert taskId from long to UUID type.

errors.message: bulkCreateTasks method signature mismatch - requires String userId and List (occurs 6 times)
errors.root_cause: TaskService.bulkCreateTasks() method signature changed to require userId as first parameter.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all bulkCreateTasks calls to: when(taskService.bulkCreateTasks(anyString(), anyList())). Add userId parameter to method calls.

Check GlobalExceptionHandler class for the correct method name for handling MethodArgumentNotValidException. Update test to call the correct method or remove tests if method was intentionally removed.

errors.message: Multiple type mismatches and missing methods in datastore tests (occurs 20 times)
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore class underwent major refactoring: userId changed from long to String, Priority changed to TaskPriority, taskId changed from long to UUID, findByUserId signature changed to require sortBy parameter, findAll() and existsById() methods were removed or renamed.
